# Copilot Instructions for Go Telegram Mini App API Project

This project is a Golang API server designed for integration with a Telegram Mini App. It includes a basic REST API structure and is ready for further development, including Telegram authentication and data exchange features.

## Project Setup Checklist
- [ ] Scaffold the Go project with a basic API server
- [ ] Add handlers for Telegram authentication and data exchange
- [ ] Ensure README.md and copilot-instructions.md are up to date
- [ ] Compile and run the project to verify setup

Follow best practices for Go development and use popular libraries for HTTP routing and Telegram integration.
